en-US.title: Keptly: Document Scanner
en-US.subtitle: PDF Scan & Deadline Reminder
en-US.description:
Scan it. Find the dates that matter. Never miss a deadline.

Keptly turns your iPhone into a document scanner that reads every page on your device and pulls out the details you would otherwise forget: expiry dates, due dates, renewal dates, totals, ID numbers, emails, phone numbers and links. No watermark. No account. No ads.

SCAN ANYTHING, INTO ONE PDF
• Automatic edge detection and straightening on every page
• Document mode for single sheets, Book mode for open books: each photo is split into two pages
• Scan many pages into one PDF, and add more pages to a scan any time
• Clean-up look for every scan: Auto, Colour, Grey or Black & White
• Rotate any page with one tap
• Import photos from your library

FINDS THE DATES THAT MATTER
• Facts tab: after a scan, see expiry, due and renewal dates, totals and contact details in one place. Tap any fact to copy it
• Deadline reminders: tap the bell on a date and Keptly reminds you 7 days before, 1 day before and on the day. Repeat reminders for yearly or monthly dates
• Deadlines screen: every upcoming date from all your scans in one list, for passports, insurance, warranties and bills
• Add any deadline to your Calendar, and see the next ones in a home-screen widget
• Receipt totals: see what you spent by month at a glance
• Share-safe text: share the text of a scan with card, Aadhaar, PAN and IBAN numbers hidden except the last four digits

SCAN AND SEARCH, FREE ALWAYS
• Unlimited scans, no watermark
• Text recognition (OCR) on your iPhone, no internet needed
• Search names and the text inside every scan
• Export a searchable PDF or the recognised text
• Choose PDF size: small, medium or original
• Lock the app with Face ID

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is processed on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded
• Reminders are scheduled on your device
• No sign-up, no tracking, no ads

KEPTLY PLUS (optional)
• Auto-sort scans into Receipts, Invoices, IDs and Letters
• Export as Word or Markdown
Monthly is $2.99 with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Yearly is $19.99 with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Lifetime is $39.99 once and does not renew. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial or period ends. Manage in your Apple ID settings.
